label: Can join as guest
summary: Whether the given character can join this activity as a guest (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it in the map icon layer: an activity icon is shown as joinable when this is true and the character is not already taking part.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes Character.Self

label: Custom text
summary: Returns a text that the game builds in code for this activity, picked by a name you give.
details: Vanilla uses it in localization to show the first or second tenet (a faith's core belief) proposed or resolved in an ecumenical council, for example 'GetEcumenicalCouncilTenet1Proposal'. Which names exist is not documented in the input.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom text to get.
fields.values: a quoted name such as 'GetEcumenicalCouncilTenet1Proposal'

label: Decline invite
summary: Declines the invitation to this activity when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from a click in the activity list window; that it declines an invitation is going by its name.

label: Active option of category
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name, it gives the option currently chosen in a category of the activity. Vanilla never uses it, so this is not confirmed.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Probably the option category; not confirmed.

label: Active start date
summary: The date on which the activity's active part starts.
details: Vanilla shows it as text with GetString ('Activity start: ...') and uses it in 'You have ... left to join (it starts in ...)', where the time between the travel plan's estimated arrival date and this date is the time left to join. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Attending characters
summary: The list of characters attending the activity.
details: Vanilla counts its entries to show the size of the guest list in the activity window. Going by its name and this use.

label: Conclusion description
summary: A text describing how the activity ended, written for the given character.
details: Vanilla shows it in the activity window with the player as the viewer. That it describes how the activity ended is going by its name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the text is written for.
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes GetPlayer

label: Creation date
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it is the date the activity was created. Vanilla never uses it on an activity; the only similar lines belong to other types (legends, memories), where GetCreationDate gives a date that shows a year or a string.

label: Current phase
summary: The phase the activity is in right now.
details: Vanilla chains further calls on it, for example to read the phase's location, the holding there and its special building. Phases are the stages an activity goes through. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Current phase number
summary: The number of the current phase in the activity's phases, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla compares it with the number from GetPhaseIndexOf to find out whether a phase is the current one. Going by its name and that comparison; the input does not say whether counting starts at 0.

label: Estimated next phase date
summary: The estimated date on which the activity moves on from its current phase.
details: Vanilla asks it for the time left to that date, in the text '... until it ends' or '... until it begins', chosen by IsCurrentPhaseActive. Going by its name and this use.

label: Guest description
summary: A text describing what joining the activity means for the given character.
details: Vanilla places it under the 'You join ...' line in the activity list's join details, with the player as the character.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the text is written for.
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes GetPlayer

label: Host
summary: The character who hosts the activity.
details: Vanilla chains calls on it, for example to read the host's rite or UI name, and passes it to the special guest type name.

label: Activity ID
summary: The activity's internal ID number.
details: Vanilla has no use of it on an activity. The lines with the same name belong to characters, where GetID shows the ID. So this rests on its name only.

label: Involvement text
summary: A text telling how the given character is involved in the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it in the activity widget and map icon tooltips. The meaning of the second input is a guess from the value 'hud'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character whose involvement is described.
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes Character.Self

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: A second input; vanilla always passes 'hud'. Probably which view the text is for, not confirmed.
fields.values: a quoted name; vanilla uses 'hud'

label: Last phase
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Its return type is a planned activity phase, so going by its name it gives the last phase of the activity. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Last weekly action
summary: The data about the latest action the activity took in its weekly update.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data source of parts of the activity window and of a popup, so they can show that action. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Log entries
summary: The list of entries in the activity's log.
details: Vanilla fills the log list of the activity locale window with it, shows an empty state when it has no entries, and counts the entries in the 'Activity Log' header.

label: Maximum guests
summary: The most guests the activity can take, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla has no use of it on an activity. The lines with the same name use it on the guest list window, where it warns when more guests are invited than the maximum. So this rests on its name and that hint.

label: Name
summary: The activity's name as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in sentences such as 'You are attending ...' and '... is already in progress'. A twin function, GetNameNoTooltip, exists; going by its name, it leaves out the hover tooltip.

label: Name, no tooltip
summary: The activity's name as text; going by the function's name, without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in the status line 'You are hosting or attending ... in', in journey names ('... journey to ...') and in the title of the join tooltip.

label: Arrived characters
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it counts the characters who have arrived at the activity. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Invited characters
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it counts the invited characters. Vanilla has no use of it on an activity; the same name is used on the activity planner for the guest buttons, as a hint only.

label: Traveling characters
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it counts the characters still traveling to the activity. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Characters still awaited
summary: The number of characters the activity is still waiting for, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it in the text 'waiting on guests, N remaining'.

label: Options
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it gives a list of options. Vanilla has no use of it on an activity; the same name is used on the event window data in the activity window, as a hint only.

label: Phase number
summary: The position of the given phase in the activity's list of phases, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla compares it with the current phase number to show or hide parts of the activity window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned activity phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

label: Planned phases
summary: The list of phases planned for the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list shown in the activity window and the tournament widget, and counts it to size the layout.

label: Planned phases count
summary: The number of phases planned for the activity, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla never uses it. Going by its name; vanilla counts the list from GetPlannedPhases instead.

label: Next phase date
summary: The date on which the activity moves to its next phase.
details: Vanilla only checks it with IsValidDate in the activity window, so a date is shown only when one is set. Going by its name and this use.

label: First chosen doctrine
summary: The first doctrine chosen for the activity, used in the ecumenical council.
details: Vanilla reads its doctrine group and the group's name in the council's debate texts. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Second chosen doctrine
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it is the second chosen doctrine, like the first one. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Third chosen doctrine
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it is the third chosen doctrine, like the first one. Vanilla never uses it.

label: First chosen tenet
summary: The first tenet (a core belief of a faith) chosen for the activity, used in the ecumenical council.
details: Vanilla asks it for its name, passing a rite, and uses it as the data context of a part of the activity window. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Second chosen tenet
summary: The second tenet (a core belief of a faith) chosen for the activity, used in the ecumenical council.
details: Vanilla asks it for its name, passing a rite, and uses it as the data context in the activity window. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Third chosen tenet
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it is the third chosen tenet, like the first one. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Short name
summary: The activity's short name as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in sentences like 'You are the host for a ...' and '... is hosting a ... in'. The NoTooltip twin presumably gives it without a hover tooltip.

label: Short name, no tooltip
summary: The activity's short name as plain text, without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla uses it in headers and warnings such as 'You may not arrive to the ... in time' and the activity log header.

label: Special guest
summary: The character who fills the named special guest role in the activity.
details: Only lines of other types are shown by the input; there the call is written on an activity with a role name such as 'spouse_1' or 'spouse_2' in a wedding invitation text, followed by a character call. This is a hint only, not proof.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a quoted role name, for example 'spouse_1'

label: Special guest type of character
summary: The kind of special guest the given character is in this activity.
details: Vanilla asks the result for its name, passing the host, to write 'You are a ... in ...', and uses it as the data context in the activity list window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes GetPlayer

label: Special guests
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it is the list of special guests. Vanilla has no use of it on an activity; the guest list window has a function with the same name, a hint only.

label: Special option
summary: A game function of the activity; the game documents nothing more.
details: Vanilla never uses it and the name does not say what the option is.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of the activity.
details: Vanilla chains calls on it for the type's name, icon and whether it is an open invite.

label: Is complete
summary: Whether the activity is finished.
details: Vanilla uses it in the HUD and the tournament widgets, often as 'valid and not complete' to decide what to show.

label: Is current phase active
summary: Whether the activity's current phase is active (running) rather than still to begin.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tournament widgets, and in a text that says the time until it 'ends' (active) or 'begins' (not active).

label: Is invited
summary: Whether the given character is invited to the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it in the map icon layer: an icon is enabled when the current phase number is 0 or lower (going by the names, the activity has not got past its first phase) or the character is invited.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes Character.Self

label: Is participant
summary: Whether the given character takes part in the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the activity icon and window for participants, and to offer joining only to those who do not yet take part.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes Character.Self

label: Is phase in the future
summary: Whether the given phase of the activity has not started yet.
details: Vanilla combines it with IsPhaseOngoing in the tournament contest information to show a part of it while a phase is coming or running and the activity is not complete.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned activity phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

label: Is phase in the past
summary: Whether the given phase of the activity is over.
details: Vanilla uses it, with IsComplete, in the tournament contest information to show a part of it once a phase is over or the activity is complete.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned activity phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

label: Is phase ongoing
summary: Whether the given phase of the activity is running right now.
details: Vanilla combines it with IsPhaseInTheFuture in the tournament contest information.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned activity phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

label: Is special guest
summary: Whether the given character is a special guest of the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it to choose the wording of the activity status text and to show different parts of the activity list window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes GetPlayer

label: Is tenet doctrine-based
summary: Whether the activity's chosen tenet is based on a doctrine.
details: Vanilla uses it only to show a part of the activity window. Going by its name and that use.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether there is a real activity here.
details: Vanilla uses it in the HUD and the activity list, usually as 'not valid or complete' to show that nothing is going on, and as 'valid and not complete' to show the running activity.

label: Make script scope
summary: Turns the activity into a script scope, so variables saved on the activity can be read in a text.
details: Vanilla chains it with Var('name') and then a character call, for example to read a character saved in the activity's variable 'debate_winner' and show its name.

label: Open activity view
summary: Opens the activity's window when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from clicks on the HUD and the map icons.

label: Remove from phase group
summary: Removes a character from a named group of one phase of the activity when it runs.
details: Vanilla runs it from tournament buttons with the player and 'contestant' or 'spectator'. Taking the character out of a group is going by its name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a planned activity phase, vanilla passes PlannedActivityPhase.Self

fields.name: Arg1
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes GetPlayer

fields.name: Arg2
fields.text: The group to remove them from.
fields.values: a quoted name, vanilla uses 'contestant' or 'spectator'

label: Remove from group
summary: Removes a character from a named group of the whole activity when it runs.
details: Vanilla runs it from a button in the tournament's list of attending knights, with 'spectator'. Taking the character out of a group is going by its name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes Character.Self

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The group to remove them from.
fields.values: a quoted name, vanilla uses 'spectator'

label: This activity
summary: The activity itself, to hand over to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it on, for example to a phase's description or to open the invite detail window for that activity.

label: Access this group item
summary: A game function of the activity group item; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the item itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Activities of group
summary: The list of activities in this group of the activity list window.
details: Vanilla fills the list under a group with it and hides the group when the list is empty.

label: Group title
summary: The title of this group of the activity list, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as the group's heading in the activity list window.

label: Group type
summary: The type of this group of the activity list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of a part of the activity list window.

label: This group item
summary: The group item itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this group type
summary: A game function of the activity group type; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the type itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Name
summary: The name of the group type, as text.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name is used on many other types for their display name, a hint only.

label: Has tag
summary: Whether the group type carries the given tag (true or false).
details: Vanilla asks for the tag 'big_button' in the activity list window and picks a taller row and button size when it is set.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a quoted tag name, vanilla uses 'big_button'

label: This group type
summary: The group type itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this guest data
summary: A game function of the activity guest data; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the data itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Character
summary: The character this guest data belongs to.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name returns a character on other types, such as the root or a council window, a hint only.

label: Estimated arrival date
summary: The date on which this guest is expected to arrive, as a date.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The same name is used on a travel plan's next destination to show 'Estimated arrival', a hint only.

label: Join chance
summary: The chance that this guest joins the activity, as a number.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The guest list window has a function with the same name that vanilla uses to say whether a guest will accept or decline, a hint only.

label: This guest data
summary: The guest data itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this invite rule
summary: A game function of the guest invite rule; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the rule itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Name
summary: The name of the guest invite rule, as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tooltips of the guest list, for example to say that a category of guests is a mandatory or optional invitation.

label: Is locked
summary: Whether the invite rule is locked, so it cannot be switched off.
details: Vanilla enables the rule's button only when this is false. The tooltip texts call locked rules 'mandatory invitation' and the others 'optional'.

label: This invite rule
summary: The invite rule itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access guest list
summary: The guest list of the guest list window, as the data context of a part of the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context in the guest list window. Going by its name and this use.

label: Access activity planner
summary: The activity planner behind the guest list window, as the data context of a part of the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context in the guest list window. Going by its name and this use.

label: Access this window
summary: A game function of the guest list window; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the window itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Access special guests
summary: The list of special guests, to fill a list in the guest list window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data model of a list in the guest list window. Going by its name and this use.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the guest list window when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the window's close buttons.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of the activity whose guests are being chosen.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the window and for the header '... Guests' with the type's name.

label: Host
summary: The host of the activity whose guests are being chosen.
details: Vanilla passes it to the special guest type name, so the name can differ for the host.

label: Join chance
summary: The chance that the given guest accepts the invitation, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows 'Will accept invitation' or 'Will decline invitation' with the total, and shows a part of the window only when it is above 0.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character list item, vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self

label: Join chance breakdown
summary: A text listing the reasons that make up the given guest's join chance.
details: Vanilla shows it in the accept and decline tooltips next to the total.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character list item, vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self

label: Maximum guests
summary: The most guests the activity can take, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows a warning, 'Over N guests have been invited', when the number of shown characters is greater than this; the text adds that some will decline the invitation.

label: Special guest being selected
summary: The special guest role the player is choosing a character for right now.
details: Vanilla asks it for its type name in the prompts 'Select an invited guest to be ...' and 'Select ...'. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Special guest invite effects
summary: A text describing what happens when the given special guest is invited.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tooltips of special guests, under the guest type's name. Going by its name and these uses; what the argument is, is not shown.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Probably the special guest; not confirmed.

label: Special guests
summary: The list of special guests of the activity.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data model of a list in the guest list window.

label: Travel time estimate
summary: The estimated travel time of the given character to the activity, in days.
details: Vanilla shows it as 'Travel: ~N days' for each character in the list.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character list item, vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self

label: Is from planning
summary: Whether the guest list window was opened from the activity planning stage.
details: Vanilla uses it to show some parts of the window only while planning and others only when it is not planning. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Is invite rule active
summary: Whether the given invite rule is switched on.
details: Vanilla uses it for the pressed state of the rule's button and in the tooltip that tells whether an optional category can be excluded.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an invite rule, vanilla passes OrderedActivityInviteRule.Self

label: Is selecting special guest
summary: Whether the player is currently choosing a special guest.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the special guest prompt and to disable the normal controls meanwhile.

label: May not arrive in time
summary: Whether the given character may not reach the activity before it starts.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a warning for that character in the list.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character list item, vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self

label: This window
summary: The guest list window itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Set special guest to select
summary: A game function of the guest list window; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it sets which special guest role is being chosen. Vanilla never uses it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: Probably the special guest role; not confirmed.

label: Toggle invite rule
summary: Switches the given invite rule on or off when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the click on a rule's button.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an invite rule, vanilla passes OrderedActivityInviteRule.Self

label: Access this intent
summary: A game function of the activity intent; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the intent itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Animation
summary: The name of the portrait animation to play for the given character with this intent.
details: Vanilla passes it to the animated portrait of a character, with the camera 'camera_lifestyles'.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character, vanilla passes Character.Self

label: Description
summary: The text describing what this intent means.
details: Vanilla shows it under the intent's name in the tooltips of the intent buttons.

label: Icon
summary: The icon image of this intent.
details: Vanilla uses it as the texture of intent icons in the activity window.

label: Name
summary: The name of this intent, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as the title of the intent's tooltip and in the coronation activity's intent text.

label: Has icon
summary: A game function of the activity intent; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it tells whether the intent has an icon. Vanilla has no use of it on an intent; the lines with the same name belong to other types (concept tooltip, law, situation phase), a hint only.

label: Has target
summary: Whether this intent needs a target (true or false).
details: Vanilla uses it in the intent selection window to show the target picker only for such intents, and to clear the saved target list for the others.

label: This intent
summary: The intent itself, to hand over to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the intent selection window to select an intent or to check whether it can be picked.

label: Access this intent data
summary: A game function of the activity intent data; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the data itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Target
summary: The target chosen for the intent.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context and checks whether it is valid, to tell if an intent that needs a target already has one.

label: Intent
summary: The intent that was chosen.
details: Vanilla uses it as a data context, and asks for its name in 'Select a target for your intent'. The name of the function says 'type', but vanilla treats the result as the intent itself.

label: This intent data
summary: The intent data itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this window
summary: A game function of the intent selection window; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the window itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Access target list
summary: The list of possible targets in the intent selection window, as a data context.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the target list. Going by its name and these uses.

label: Can confirm
summary: Whether the player can confirm the choice in the intent selection window.
details: Vanilla enables the confirm button only when this is true. GetCanConfirmDesc gives the tooltip text.

label: Can pick intent
summary: Whether the given intent can be chosen.
details: Vanilla enables the intent's button only when this is true. GetCanPickIntentDesc gives the reason text.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an activity intent, vanilla passes ActivityIntent.Self

label: Close window
summary: Closes the intent selection window when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the window's close buttons.

label: Confirm
summary: Confirms the chosen intent when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the confirm button.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of the activity the intent is chosen for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the window.

label: Can confirm description
summary: A text explaining whether and why the choice can or cannot be confirmed.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of the confirm button.

label: Can pick intent description
summary: A text explaining whether and why the given intent can be picked.
details: Vanilla adds it as a paragraph to the intent's tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an activity intent

label: Potential intents
summary: The list of intents the player may choose from.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data model of the intent list in the window.

label: Potential targets
summary: A game function of the intent selection window; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it is the list of possible targets. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Selected intent
summary: The intent the player has selected in the window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the parts that show the chosen intent.

label: May not arrive in time
summary: Whether the given character may not reach the activity before it starts.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a warning for a character in the window's list.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a character list item, vanilla passes CharacterListItem.Self

label: Select intent
summary: Chooses the given intent when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the click on an intent's button.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: an activity intent, vanilla passes ActivityIntent.Self

label: Select target
summary: A game function of the intent selection window; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it chooses a target for the intent. Vanilla never uses it.

label: This window
summary: The intent selection window itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this item
summary: A game function of the activity list item; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the item itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Activity
summary: The activity of this item in the activity list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the item in the activity list window.

label: Activity type
summary: The activity type of this item in the activity list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the item in the activity list window.

label: Is ongoing
summary: Whether the activity of this item is running now.
details: Vanilla uses it in the activity list to show running activities in one way and others, which the player may plan, in another.

label: This item
summary: The activity list item itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this host view
summary: A game function of the host detail view; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the view itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Can confirm
summary: Whether the player can confirm hosting the activity.
details: Vanilla enables the confirm button of the host detail view only when this is true.

label: Close view
summary: Closes the host detail view when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from a button in the activity list window.

label: Confirm
summary: Confirms the choice to host the activity when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the confirm button of the view. Going by its name and this use for what is confirmed.

label: Confirm click sound
summary: The sound played when the confirm button is clicked.
details: Vanilla uses it as the click sound of the confirm button.

label: Confirm tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the confirm button.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the confirm button.

label: Cost description
summary: A text describing what hosting the activity costs.
details: Vanilla shows it as the text of the cost line in the host detail view; that line is visible only when HasCost is true.

label: Effect description
summary: A text describing the effects of hosting the activity.
details: The input shows no use on this type. Other types have a function with the same name that describes effects, such as a building's, a hint only.

label: Requirements description
summary: A text describing what is required to host the activity.
details: Vanilla shows it as a line in the host detail view, which is shown only when HasRequirements is true.

label: Activity type
summary: The type of the activity the view is about.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the view.

label: Has cost
summary: Whether hosting the activity has a cost.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the cost line only when there is something to show.

label: Has effect
summary: Whether hosting the activity has an effect to show.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name belong to the decision detail view, where it shows an effects part, a hint only.

label: Has requirements
summary: Whether hosting the activity has requirements to show.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the requirements line only when there is something to show.

label: This host view
summary: The host detail view itself, to hand over to another function.
details: The input shows no use on this type. The lines with the same name show Self passed on by other types, a hint only.

label: Access this join view
summary: A game function of the join detail view; the game documents nothing more.
details: Going by its name it hands over the view itself in a form that can be changed. The lines with the same name pass PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf to a window call, a hint only.

label: Close view
summary: Closes the join detail view when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from a button in the activity list window.

label: Confirm
summary: Confirms joining the activity when it runs.
details: It returns nothing. Vanilla runs it from the confirm button of the join view. Going by its name and this use for what is confirmed.

label: Activity
summary: The activity the join view is about.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data context of the view.

label: Estimated travel time
summary: The estimated travel time to the activity, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it as 'Travel Time: ~...' in the join details, passed through GetTimeDifferenceWithDays. The unit is not stated; presumably days.

label: Invitation text
summary: The invitation text shown in the join detail view.
details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the join view of the activity list window.
